jobs.occupation: Marketing Manager Global Campaigns (Fachwirt/in - Marketing/Bachelor Professional in Marketing)
jobs.description: ENERCON GmbHIn your role, you will shape the global campaign framework of ENERCON's solutions portfolio - from wind turbines and service offerings to our extended range of solutions, such as industrial power solutions. You'll turn target audiences, positioning and key messages into scalable global campaign frameworks, using a thoughtful customer journey and a clear content and channel architecture to give every activity its place.- From there, you'll bring the campaign to life across channels, steering the development and delivery of the right assets - from content and digital activities to event, presentation and sales enablement materials.- Making it happen is a shared effort. Working closely with Product and Solutions Management, Sales, and other internal and external partners, you'll keep campaign projects moving across functions, markets and regions. You'll also support your colleagues in Corporate Communications and Global Marketing on overarching corporate campaigns when needed.- The journey doesn't end with the first response. Your campaigns will attract qualified leads and nurture their interest, with lead nurturing processes and a handover to Sales that you'll shape and improve in close collaboration with the sales team.- A global idea needs to connect locally. You'll equip regional Marketing and Communications teams to adapt campaigns to their markets, while giving Sales relevant messages, materials and ideas to engage customers.- What works well should make the next campaign stronger. By turning proven approaches into campaign standards, reusable building blocks and clear processes, you'll help our campaigns scale globally, make better use of automation and run more efficiently.Your profile:- B2B marketing and campaign management are familiar territory: you bring several years of experience, ideally gained in an international industrial, technology or energy business.- Behind a complex solution or technology, you can find the story that matters to customers. You combine a sound understanding of products and solutions with a feel for customer needs, turning that knowledge into clear messages and campaign approaches that support Sales.- For you, a campaign is more than a collection of activities. It's about connecting audiences, messaging, content, channels and timing, right through to sales enablement - always with customer needs, sales relevance and measurable results in mind.- You communicate clearly and reliably, write with precision and a strong sense of your audience, and work confidently across functions, regions and organisational levels.- Good ideas make you want to get started. You enjoy turning them into action, working independently with structure, pragmatism and a hands-on mindset.- Marketing automation is a practical part of your craft. From campaign set-up and lead nurturing to email marketing and performance reporting, you know how the pieces fit together.- Paid social is familiar ground, too. You have experience with LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram and work confidently with audiences, ad formats, budgets and performance metrics.- Curiosity keeps you looking for better ways to work. You see the potential in new tools for automation, personalisation, content production and campaign management, and bring your own ideas to the conversation.- Excellent written and spoken German (C1/C2) is essential for this role, as many of our campaigns and their content are developed and delivered in German. Very good written and spoken English is equally important for the international roll-out of campaigns and for working confidently across our international organisation.
